data.description: A blaze of claw and fang.  The speed of these nether world creatures is almost without compare.
data.name: Cacodaemon Warrior

data.description: Normally they feed on only the dead, but in times of hunger they will hunt their prey.  They are semi-intelligent and travel with other that feed on carrion.
data.name: Carrion Beast

data.description: Neither very fast nor powerful. These nasty reptiles do have one advantage - a poisonous bite.
data.name: Dinosaur

data.description: An apparition from beyond the grave.  Niether good nor evil by nature, it is still best to avoid such creatures.
data.name: Ghost
